title: How is MatPat connected to Napoleon?
description: Congress, a president, two queens and two paintings link MatPat to Napoleon.
hook: How is MatPat connected to Napoleon?

links.line: In 2025, MatPat spoke at the Capitol beside Congresswoman Yvette Clarke, launching a caucus for creators.
In 2010, Clarke stood with Speaker Nancy Pelosi at a press event on the Capitol steps.
Also in 2010, Pelosi stood right behind Barack Obama as he signed his health care law.

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: In 2009, President Obama and Michelle met Queen Elizabeth the Second at Buckingham Palace.

image.file: File:Queen Mary with Princess Elizabeth and Margaret.jpg

links.line: Back in 1939, a young Princess Elizabeth posed with her grandmother, Queen Mary.
In 1895, Mary sat beside Queen Victoria at Balmoral, holding her baby son, the future Edward the Eighth.

image.file: File:Edward Matthew Ward (1816-79) - Queen Victoria at the Tomb of Napoleon, 24 August 1855 - RCIN 402019 - Royal Collection.jpg

links.line: This painting shows Victoria in 1855, visiting Napoleon's tomb in Paris with Emperor Napoleon the Third.
And in this 1810 painting, the baby on Napoleon's knee is his nephew, the future Napoleon the Third.
